description: This file defines the FileSecurity class in the Drupal framework, providing functions to generate and write .htaccess files for directory security, including access restrictions and execution prevention.

classes.name: FileSecurity
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing directory security via .htaccess files in Drupal.

methods.name: writeHtaccess
methods.description: Creates or overwrites an .htaccess file in a specified directory with security directives.

methods.name: htaccessLines
methods.description: Generates the content for an .htaccess file, either allowing public access or denying it.

methods.name: htaccessPreventExecution
methods.description: Returns directives to prevent script execution in a directory.

methods.name: denyPublicAccess
methods.description: Returns directives to block all access to a directory.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes specified contents to a file in a directory, with optional force overwrite.
